[[Dauv Merishahl]] is a collector, a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for weapons.

==Locations==
*[[The Jade Sea]]
**{{NPC location|Cavalon}} (near [[storage]] next to the exit of [[Archipelagos]])

==Dialogue==
:''"[[Oni]] are curious creatures. We of the [[Turtle Clan]] believe they were once human but have become twisted by terrible nightmares from deep within the Jade Sea. They are similar to the [[Luxon]]s known as [[Outcast]]s, driven to the edge of insanity and irrationally violent. Oni may hold the key to discovering the true nature of the Outcasts. Bring me 2 Keen Oni Talons, and I'll give you this in return:"''
